source.title: The Conjuring
source.description:
The demon, Des'Altek, seems to have broken free of it's prison, but its still bound to it like a prisoner to their cell. We must summon forth the demon to capture its soul again.

To the north, in Ashenvale, where great demons fell, there is a location on the ridge that was once used by the Legion for sacrifices. The ground is permanently scarred from the atrocities that occurred here, but if we can gather the Blood of the Legion from the demons that still infest this land... that's the key.
source.objective: Collect 10 Blood of the Legion and perform the ritual to summon Des'Altek to trap its soul once again.
source.completion: Use the Dark Ritual Stone to begin the Dark Ritual. There's no turning back now...
